name: Meteor Blow
evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 454 current-evidence enrichment: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ9 and a starting-skill option for the close-up fighting style. The opening upkick launches the opponent diagonally upward, then the user teleports in front of the flight path for a finishing kick. The first hit can be Ki-confirmed into the teleport follow-up, and the resulting knockback can enable some slower supers; exact frame windows and damage scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
